2026_04_GB_TB.headline: Green Bay visits Tampa as the Buccaneers adjust without Baker Mayfield
2026_04_GB_TB.paragraph1: Green Bay gets another road test against a Tampa Bay team preparing to play without Baker Mayfield, whose thumb injury is expected to keep him out for multiple weeks. That shifts the burden toward Tampa Bay’s protection, run game and defense to keep the replacement quarterback out of obvious passing situations. The Packers can press that adjustment by winning early downs and forcing longer drives. Tampa Bay’s defense, including strong early coverage work from Zyon McCollum, must prevent Green Bay from finding easy explosive completions.
2026_04_GB_TB.model_rationale: Tampa Bay’s quarterback change magnifies protection and early-down efficiency, while Green Bay can create leverage by forcing the Buccaneers into predictable passing situations.
